title: Cage To Jar!
description: Retexture of the Supplementaries' cage to a jar - Because of... reasons
body: - Why I did this? - Not sure - Do I feel shame for myself? - Yeah, a bit - Do I regret this? - HELL NAH   Made as a joke about... well.. that story... I replaced the Cage model from Supplementaries with the Jar model from the same mod, but changed the visual dimensions to fit some mobs better.  REQUIRES THE [SUPPLEMENTARIES](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries) MOD If you use some mods like the [MiniMePets](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/minimepets) or the [MLP Villagers (Fabric)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mine-little-pony-villagers), you may get a funnier experience. Shame on you for getting the joke and using this pack, and shame on me for making it. Your wolf can go from this: To this: Or if you use the MiniMePets mod you can do it with yourself or your friends! From:  To:
